section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Theft Deterrent System
title: INSPECTION OF IGNITION SWITCH CIRCUIT

content.description: Flowchart for inspecting ignition switch circuit. Starts with turning ignition switch to ON or ACC position, checks CIG fuse, tests for short circuit and open circuit conditions, and ends with either replacing fuse, replacing computer, or identifying wire harness issues.
labels: Turn ignition switch to ON or ACC position.
Short circuit in wire harness between fuse and terminal 4 of computer.
INSPECT IGNITION SWITCH CIRCUIT - Disconnect connector from computer. Is there battery voltage between terminal 4 of wire harness side connector and body ground?
Open circuit in wire harness between fuse and terminal 4 of computer.
